items.title: 「AI股拋售過度！」大摩放話別瞎賣：資料中心建設僅延後非取消  續抱亞馬遜、微軟等四騎士
items.title_en: AI Stocks Oversold! Morgan Stanley Warns Not to Sell Blindly: Data Center Buildouts Only Delayed, Not Canceled – Still Backing Amazon, Microsoft and the Other Three "Knights"
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)出具最新研究報告指出，近期市場因憂心美國期中大選結果恐拖累資料中心建設，引發AI概念股一輪拋售，但這波跌勢明顯反應過度。
大摩強調，AI資本支出大趨勢未變，部分項目僅是時程遞延而非取消，超大型雲端服務商的投資計畫大體維持不變。
大摩表示，原先預計2028年落成的約5GW美國資料中心規劃容量，可能順延至2029年，但不會被一刀砍除。這種「建設節奏微調」反而有助紓解短期供應鏈瓶頸、支撐算力定價，進而拉長整個AI投資周期的能見度。
在標的選擇上，大摩重申看好亞馬遜、微軟、Meta與Alphabet等主要AI受惠股，並在半導體、基礎設施與軟體領域中也搜尋到具吸引力的布局機會。
大摩認為，市場將選舉變數過度解讀為結構性逆風，卻忽略雲端巨頭穩健的現金流與算力剛性需求。短期震盪反而為長線資金創造進場良機，AI基礎設施擴張的長期路徑依然清晰。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (hereafter "MS") issued a latest research report noting that recently the market, worried that the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections could drag on data‑center construction, triggered a round of selling in AI‑concept stocks, but this drop appears to be an overreaction.

MS emphasized that the overall trend of AI capital spending remains unchanged; some projects are merely postponed rather than cancelled, and the investment plans of the ultra‑large cloud service providers remain broadly intact.

MS said that the roughly 5 GW of U.S. data‑center capacity originally slated for completion in 2028 may be pushed to 2029, but will not be cut outright. This modest “construction‑pace adjustment” could actually ease short‑term supply‑chain bottlenecks, support compute pricing, and extend the visibility of the entire AI investment cycle.

Regarding stock selection, MS reiterated its bullish view on primary AI beneficiaries such as Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Alphabet, and also identified attractive positioning opportunities in semiconductors, infrastructure and software.

MS believes the market has over‑interpreted the election variable as a structural headwind, overlooking the cloud giants’ solid cash flows and the rigid demand for compute. The short‑term wobble instead creates a good entry point for long‑term capital, and the long‑term path for AI‑infrastructure expansion remains clear.

items.title: 電動皮卡Cybertruck明年停產 馬斯克：將向大批客戶退還訂金
items.title_en: Tesla Cybertruck Electric Pickup to Cease Production Next Year, Musk Says Deposits Will Be Refunded to Many Customers
paras: 消費者支付訂金也未必能買到最後一批下線Cybertruck電動皮卡，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克9日（周一）表示，Cybertruck訂單量「遠遠超過」明年停產前能夠完成的生產能力。
馬斯克在社交平台X上發文：「在大約8個月後關閉生產線之前，我們會盡可能生產，但也不得不向很多客戶退還訂金。」
馬斯克強調，Cybertruck並非一款虧損車型，但相比之下，擴大特斯拉Cybercab無人駕駛計程車的生產規模更重要。
他表示：「維持Cybertruck生產所帶來的複雜性，機會成本遠遠超過增加Cybercab產量所能創造的價值。」
馬斯克6日宣布，將停止生產2023年正式推出的Cybertruck。目前尚不清楚特斯拉手中還有多少未交付訂單，而特斯拉官網似乎仍在接受消費者下單。
Cybertruck最初肩負著展示特斯拉最新電動車技術、打開高利潤皮卡市場的雙重使命。馬斯克曾向投資者表示，這將是特斯拉「有史以來最好的產品」。他當時預計特斯拉每年能夠銷售25萬輛Cybertruck，但實際市場表現遠不如預期。
去年特斯拉在美國僅售出約2萬輛Cybertruck；2026年以來，累計銷量也只有1.6萬輛左右。此外，在馬斯克執掌美國政府效率部期間，Cybertruck還成為反馬斯克抗議活動和惡意破壞行為的目標。
與此同時，Cybertruck的市場表現也恰逢美國電動車市場走弱。消費者需求未能達到汽車製造商預期，整個電動車行業的發展勢頭隨之放緩。
美國電動車稅額抵免政策終止加劇了這一趨勢。頗具諷刺意味的是，推動這一政策變化的正是美國總統川普及共和黨主導的國會。
paras_en: Consumers who paid deposits may still not receive the final batch of the Cybertruck electric pickup, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk said on Monday the 9th that Cybertruck order volume "far exceeds" the production capacity that can be completed before the shutdown next year.
Musk posted on X: "We will produce as much as possible before we shut the line down in about eight months, but we will also have to refund deposits to many customers."
Musk stressed that the Cybertruck is not an unprofitable model, but expanding production of Tesla’s Cybercab autonomous taxi fleet is comparatively more important.
He added: "Maintaining the complexity of Cybertruck production carries an opportunity cost far greater than the value that could be created by increasing Cybercab output."

Musk announced on the 6th that production of the Cybertruck, officially launched in 2023, will be halted. It remains unclear how many undelivered orders Tesla still holds, and the Tesla website appears to still be accepting consumer orders.

The Cybertruck was originally tasked with showcasing Tesla’s latest EV technology and opening the high‑margin pickup market. Musk had told investors it would be "the best product Tesla has ever made" and projected annual sales of 250,000 units, but actual market performance fell far short of expectations.

Last year Tesla sold only about 20,000 Cybertrucks in the United States; since 2026 cumulative sales have been roughly 16,000. Moreover, during Musk’s tenure heading the U.S. Department of Efficiency, the Cybertruck became a target of anti‑Musk protests and vandalism.

At the same time, the Cybertruck’s market performance coincided with a weakening U.S. electric‑vehicle market. Consumer demand failed to meet automakers’ expectations, slowing the overall momentum of the EV industry.
The termination of the U.S. EV tax‑credit policy has intensified this trend, a change driven paradoxically by President Trump and a Republican‑controlled Congress.

items.title: 看好AI廣告變現 摩通焦點名單納Meta、移除Alphabet
items.title_en: Optimistic about AI Ad Monetization, JPMorgan Adds Meta and Removes Alphabet from Focus List
paras: 摩根大通將Meta(META-US)納入「分析師焦點名單」(Analyst Focus List)，同時移除Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，看好Meta透過人工智慧(AI)改善廣告成效，帶動近期獲利成長。不過，這項調整不代表摩根大通轉空Alphabet，該行仍維持其「加碼」(Overweight)評等。
摩根大通分析師Doug Anmuth在9日報告中寫道：「第三季財報公布後，Meta相對於同業的廣告優勢，比以往任何時候都更加明顯。」調整後，Meta與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)成為摩根大通網路股研究範圍內的偏好標的。
Anmuth指出，Meta第三季廣告營收年增26%，北美市場增幅加速至33%。摩根大通估計，Meta當季新增廣告營收約130億美元，約為Google搜尋新增金額的兩倍，並預期Meta旗下應用程式家族的廣告營收，自第四季起將超越Google搜尋。
摩根大通將Meta廣告業務的成長，歸因於AI改善廣告檢索、排序及受眾鎖定，協助提高廣告轉換率。該行也認為，Meta龐大的廣告客戶基礎及跨產業布局，有助降低個別產業廣告支出疲弱的影響。
除了核心廣告業務，Anmuth也看好Meta的AI產品商機，包括Meta Model API與Muse Code的企業市場機會。相較之下，摩根大通認為，Alphabet改善AI搜尋變現的成效，可能仍需要時間。
摩根大通指出，Google搜尋第三季營收年增率放緩至12%，低於第一季的19%及第二季的17%，儘管Google表示，搜尋查詢量創下五年來最快成長速度。
Google管理層將匯率列為搜尋營收成長減速的最大因素，其他原因包括歐盟調整小額包裹免稅規定後，亞洲零售商減少支出，以及世界盃結束後，媒體與娛樂業的廣告支出下降。
摩根大通仍看好Google，但認為AI搜尋的變現改善可能需要時間。《The Fly》引述該行報告指出，Alphabet未來幾季的利潤率，也可能受到過渡性運算資源協議的壓力。
這次名單調整的重點，是摩根大通對兩家公司AI變現進度的不同評估。該行認為，Meta的AI技術已在改善核心廣告業務的經濟效益，新消費者與企業產品則提供額外成長機會；Alphabet雖維持「加碼」評等，卻不再列於該行最偏好的網路股之中。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase has added Meta (META-US) to its Analyst Focus List while removing Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US), betting that Meta will boost recent profit growth by using artificial intelligence (AI) to improve ad performance. The move does not signal a bearish stance on Alphabet, as the firm retains an Overweight rating on the stock.

JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth wrote in a report on the 9th that “after the Q3 earnings release, Meta’s advertising advantage over peers is clearer than ever.” After the adjustment, Meta and Amazon (AMZN-US) become JPMorgan’s preferred names within its internet‑stock research coverage.

Anmuth noted that Meta’s Q3 ad revenue grew 26% year‑over‑year, with North America accelerating to a 33% increase. JPMorgan estimates Meta added about $13 billion of ad revenue that quarter, roughly twice Google Search’s incremental amount, and expects Meta’s family of apps to surpass Google Search in ad revenue starting in Q4.

JPMorgan attributes Meta’s ad‑business growth to AI‑enhanced ad retrieval, ranking and audience targeting, which lifts conversion rates. The firm also believes Meta’s massive advertiser base and cross‑industry reach help cushion the impact of weak ad spend in any single sector.

Beyond its core ad business, Anmuth is bullish on Meta’s AI product opportunities, including the Meta Model API and Muse Code for enterprise markets. By contrast, JPMorgan thinks Alphabet’s progress in monetizing AI‑enhanced search may still take time.

JPMorgan points out that Google Search’s Q3 revenue year‑over‑year growth slowed to 12%, down from 19% in Q1 and 17% in Q2, even though Google said search query volume hit its fastest five‑year growth rate.

Google’s management cites currency effects as the biggest drag on search‑revenue growth, with other factors including reduced spending by Asian retailers after the EU adjusted low‑value parcel tax exemptions and a dip in media and entertainment ad spend following the World Cup’s end.

JPMorgan remains positive on Google but believes improvements in AI‑search monetization will take time. “The Fly” quoted the firm’s report saying Alphabet’s profit margins in upcoming quarters could also be pressured by transitional compute‑resource agreements.

The focus‑list change underscores JPMorgan’s differing assessments of the two companies’ AI‑monetization progress. The firm sees Meta’s AI already enhancing the economics of its core ad business and offering new consumer and enterprise growth avenues, while Alphabet, despite retaining an Overweight rating, is no longer among the firm’s top‑preferred internet stocks.

items.title: 黃仁勳早在婚外情曝光前就聘危機公關公司！Heller Inc.曾處理多起知名性醜聞
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Hired Crisis PR Firm Before Affair Was Exposed; Heller Inc. Has Handled Multiple High‑Profile Sex Scandals
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳據傳早在公開承認婚外情前至少一年，就已聘請一家曾協助知名人士處理性醜聞與性不當指控的危機公關公司Heller Inc.。
根據《Wired》報導，2025年10月《紐約時報》刊出一篇探討輝達是否協助中國企業規避美國晶片出口限制的報導後不久，輝達內部公關團隊便接獲指示，凡是媒體詢問黃仁勳相關問題，都應將Heller Inc.列入電子郵件副本。
《紐時》當時報導，一家與中國有關聯、當時鮮為人知的新加坡資料中心公司Megaspeed，已取得價值近20億美元的輝達晶片。
報導也提到，Megaspeed執行長黃樂（Alice Huang），也就是後來被指與黃仁勳有關聯的女性，曾在台北一場輝達客戶聚會上站在黃仁勳身旁。
根據《紐約雜誌》2023年的一篇人物專題，Heller Inc.創辦人海勒（Risa Heller）曾協助多名知名男性處理個人醜聞及性不當行為指控。
據報導，她的客戶包括前任美國眾議院議員韋納（Anthony Weiner）、名廚巴塔利（Mario Batali），以及《紐約客》（The New Yorker）前撰稿人圖賓（Jeffrey Toobin）。
黃樂後來也因與黃仁勳的關係受到關注。輝達周日（8日）公布黃仁勳的一份聲明，他在聲明中承認曾與一名前Megaspeed高層發生婚外情，但並未點名黃樂。
另一方面，輝達董事會也宣布將展開獨立調查，理由是有報導指出，黃仁勳「曾成為外國情報機構行動的目標」。
截至目前，Heller Inc.與輝達均未立即回應媒體的置評請求。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is reported to have hired crisis‑public‑relations firm Heller Inc., which has helped well‑known figures manage sexual scandal and misconduct allegations, at least a year before he publicly admitted to an extramarital affair.

According to Wired, shortly after the New York Times ran a October 2025 story examining whether NVIDIA helped Chinese firms evade U.S. chip export restrictions, NVIDIA’s internal PR team was instructed to copy Heller Inc. on any media inquiries about Jensen Huang.
The New York Times reported that a little‑known Singapore data‑center company with ties to China, Megaspeed, had secured nearly $2 billion worth of NVIDIA chips.
The report also noted that Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang, the woman later alleged to have a connection with Jensen Huang, stood beside him at a NVIDIA customer gathering in Taipei.
A 2023 New York Magazine profile said Heller Inc. founder Risa Heller has assisted several high‑profile men in handling personal scandals and sexual‑misconduct accusations.
Her client list reportedly includes former U.S. Representative Anthony Weiner, celebrity chef Mario Batali, and former New Yorker writer Jeffrey Toobin.

Alice Huang later drew scrutiny for her alleged link to Jensen Huang. On Sunday the 8th, NVIDIA released a statement in which Huang admitted to an affair with a former Megaspeed executive, without naming Alice Huang.
Separately, NVIDIA’s board announced it will launch an independent investigation after reports suggested Huang “has become a target of foreign intelligence operations.”
To date, neither Heller Inc. nor NVIDIA has responded to media requests for comment.

items.title: 資料中心減速反成利多！Dan Ives：AI革命不會取消 手握現成算力的巨頭更值錢
items.title_en: Slowing Data Center Growth Turns Into a Boon! Dan Ives: The AI Revolution Won’t Halt – Giants With Ready‑Made Compute Power Are Even More Valuable
paras: 美國期中選舉後，民主黨在國會取得優勢，加上地方居民反對資料中心興建的聲浪升高，美國AI資料中心擴張速度可能因此放緩。
不過，投資機構Yorkville Ives分析師Dan Ives提出不同看法，認為供給收縮未必是AI產業利空，反而可能讓已經擁有資料中心、電力資源及GPU算力的大型科技公司更具價值。

Ives指出，這波政治變化對超大規模雲端服務商可能是「極大利多」，包括微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US)、亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)及Meta Platforms (META-US)，部分情境下甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US)也可能受惠。原因在於，當新資料中心供給受到限制，已經建置並投入運作的算力資產將變得更加稀缺，擁有現成基礎設施的企業可望取得競爭優勢。
Ives在給客戶的研究報告中估計，美國原定興建的800至1,000座資料中心，約有10%可能不會落成；若情況進一步惡化，未來18個月取消比例可能升至30%。在這種情境下，已經擁有運作中資料中心、電力容量及GPU的業者，其資產價值將明顯提高。
不過，Ives強調，資料中心建設放緩不代表AI投資熱潮終結。即使採取最悲觀的取消情境，未來幾年整體資本支出仍可能維持在3兆至4兆美元，單是大型科技公司的資本支出，明年就可能超過1兆美元。
他認為，民主黨在期中選舉後取得政治優勢，主要是讓大型科技公司的資本支出成長高峰提前，而非取消投資計畫。原先預估資本支出成長高峰落在2028年至2029年，如今可能提前至2027年，AI革命仍將持續，只是建設與投資步調可能放慢。
德州新任州長Gina Hinojosa的政策立場，也將成為後續觀察重點。德州是美國資料中心建設的重要市場，SpaceX (SpaceX) (SPCX-US)及特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US)等企業在當地均有重要布局。Hinojosa勝選後接受電視節目訪問時表示，她並不希望永久停止資料中心興建，而是希望讓相關建設對企業與居民都更加公平。
從供給規模來看，美國今年底預計將新增約40吉瓦(GW)資料中心容量，明年則預計再有40至50吉瓦容量完工並投入運作。由於新增供給規模龐大，任何政策變動或建設時程調整，都可能對產業投資及供應鏈產生顯著影響。
對半導體產業而言，Ives認為，資料中心建設未來3至4年可能分散進行，有助於緩解市場對過度興建及產能過剩的疑慮。他並預估，建設速度放緩可能使大型科技公司明年的融資需求減少約25%，降低短期資金壓力。
Ives也提醒民主黨領導層，包括預計出任眾議院議長的Hakeem Jeffries，在推動美國資料中心建設降速時必須審慎拿捏。若政治角力過度限制美國AI基礎設施發展，可能反而讓中國在未來幾年的全球AI競賽中取得領先地位。
整體而言，Ives的核心判斷是，AI產業的長期投資方向並未改變，真正改變的是基礎設施供給增加的速度與資本支出的時間分布。當新建資料中心面臨更多限制，既有算力、電力與資料中心資源的稀缺性可能上升，讓已具備基礎設施的大型科技巨頭相較仍須大量投入建設的業者，更有機會在下一階段AI競爭中占據優勢。
paras_en: After the U.S. midterm elections, Democrats gained a congressional edge and local opposition to data‑center construction rose, which could slow the expansion of AI data centers in the United States.

However, Yorkville Ives analyst Dan Ives offered a different view, arguing that a supply contraction isn’t necessarily a downside for the AI industry and could actually increase the value of large tech firms that already own data centers, power resources and GPU compute.

Ives said this political shift could be a "massive tailwind" for ultra‑large cloud providers such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Meta Platforms (META‑US), and in some scenarios even Oracle (ORCL‑US). The reason is that when new data‑center supply is constrained, the compute assets already built and operating become scarcer, giving companies with existing infrastructure a competitive edge.

In a research note to clients, Ives estimated that of the 800 to 1,000 data centers originally planned in the U.S., about 10% may not be completed; if conditions worsen, the cancellation rate could rise to 30% over the next 18 months. In that scenario, operators that already have active data centers, power capacity and GPUs would see a clear boost in asset value.

Ives stressed that a slowdown in data‑center construction does not mean the AI investment boom is over. Even under the most pessimistic cancellation scenario, total capital expenditures over the next few years could still stay between $3 trillion and $4 trillion, and large tech companies alone might spend more than $1 trillion next year.

He believes the Democrats’ post‑midterm political advantage mainly advances the peak of large‑tech capital spending rather than cancelling projects. The peak, previously expected in 2028‑2029, may now arrive in 2027, meaning the AI revolution will continue even if the build‑out and investment pace slows.

The policy stance of Texas’s new governor Gina Hinojosa will also be closely watched. Texas is a key market for U.S. data‑center construction, with companies such as SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US) having major footprints there. After winning, Hinojosa told a TV interview she does not want to permanently halt data‑center builds but wants construction to be fairer to both businesses and residents.

In terms of supply, the U.S. is expected to add about 40 GW of data‑center capacity by the end of this year, with another 40‑50 GW slated for completion and operation next year. Because the added supply is large, any policy shift or schedule change could significantly affect industry investment and the supply chain.

For the semiconductor sector, Ives sees data‑center construction spreading over the next three to four years, which could ease concerns about over‑building and excess capacity. He also estimates that a slower build‑out could cut large tech companies’ financing needs next year by roughly 25%, reducing short‑term funding pressure.

Ives cautions Democratic leaders, including the expected House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries, to tread carefully when slowing U.S. data‑center construction. Over‑politicizing could curb America’s AI infrastructure development and inadvertently give China a lead in the global AI race in the coming years.

Overall, Ives’ core judgment is that the long‑term investment direction of the AI industry remains unchanged; what shifts is the speed of infrastructure supply growth and the timing of capital spending. When new data‑center projects face tighter limits, the scarcity of existing compute, power and facility resources could rise, giving large tech giants with existing infrastructure a better chance to dominate the next phase of AI competition.

items.title: 輝達中國問題早被盯上！「諜報系」神秘空頭半年前就出手 40頁報告掀關注
items.title_en: Nvidia's China Issue Was Flagged Early! Mysterious Short Seller from the "Spy" Circle Acted Six Months Ago, 40-Page Report Sparks Attention
paras: 5月中旬，一家鮮為人知、以美國獨立戰爭期間喬治・華盛頓旗下間諜網命名的放空機構，公開警告輝達(NVDA-US) 面臨中國問題。然而，當時市場投資人並未理會，輝達股價當天反而大漲逾 2%，創下該月最大單日漲幅之一。
六個月後，Culper Research創辦人Christian Lamarco針對輝達撰寫的40頁報告，終於開始受到關注。該報告除了引用《彭博社》與《紐約時報》的報導外，也結合 Culper 的自家研究。
Lamarco在報告中直言，輝達執行長黃仁勳與 Megaspeed International 高層黃樂(Alice Huang)的關係「密切得令人不安」。
自Culper揭露放空部位以來，輝達股價已下跌約20%，同期標普500指數則上漲約2%。
黃仁勳承認婚外情後，輝達董事會宣布展開調查，週一(9日)股價盤中一度重挫8.8%。此前一系列報導指出，黃仁勳成為Megaspeed高層黃樂鎖定的目標，美國政府懷疑她遭中國間諜機構吸收。
Culper未針對此次做出回應，也未揭露放空輝達的金額，以及是否已平倉。
專攻涉嫌誤導投資人的企業
Culper主要放空其認為誤導投資人的上市公司，但多數標的並非家喻戶曉的企業。該機構過去曾發布針對Rumble、AppLovin及LifeMD的報告。
Lamarco較受矚目的放空案例之一，是去年押注空中計程車業者Archer Aviation (ACHR-US) 股價下跌。當時，電視主持人Jimmy Fallon邀請Archer執行長登上《今夜秀》，Culper隨後向Fallon提出100萬美元的對賭提議。
創辦人背景低調 承襲獨立戰爭諜報精神
Lamarco個人極為低調。根據其 LinkedIn 檔案（未標明具體公司名稱），他在一家資產規模 100 億美元的共同基金實習一個夏天後，於一家多空對沖基金擔任了兩年的分析師。
另據校友會刊顯示，他畢業於位於匹茲堡以北約 60 英里的格羅夫城學院（Grove City College）。
Culper Research的名稱源自「Culper Ring」，這個間諜網成立於18世紀末美國獨立戰爭期間，負責蒐集並傳遞當時遭英軍占領的紐約市軍隊動向情報。
Culper Research在官網表示：「同樣地，我們以全面、深入調查的方式進行投資研究。我們致力揭露那些不實陳述營運狀況、未揭露重大風險、不當運用資金、存在會計違規，或以其他方式欺騙投資人的公司。」該網站未揭露資產管理規模。
Culper揭露放空輝達部位後不久，這家科技巨頭的股價便創下歷史新高，當時整體市場對人工智慧（AI）的熱情仍十分高漲。
Culper當時寫道：「這不是押注AI失敗。我們放空輝達只有一個理由：這家公司面臨嚴重的中國問題。」
輝達董事會表達對黃仁勳的信心，並表示「沒有理由相信國家安全或輝達機密遭到洩露」，但承諾調查「將檢視所有可取得的資訊」。
中國則已否認相關間諜指控。
paras_en: In mid‑May, a little‑known short‑selling firm named after George Washington's spy network during the American Revolutionary War publicly warned that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) faced a China problem. Yet investors ignored it, and Nvidia's stock jumped more than 2% that day, marking one of the month’s biggest single‑day gains.

Six months later, a 40‑page report on Nvidia written by Culper Research founder Christian Lamarco finally attracted notice. In addition to citing Bloomberg and the New York Times, the report also incorporated Culper’s own research.
Lamarco wrote in the report that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with Megaspeed International executive Alice Huang was "uncomfortably close."
Since Culper disclosed its short position, Nvidia’s share price has fallen about 20%, while the S&P 500 index has risen roughly 2% over the same period.

After Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, Nvidia’s board announced an investigation; the stock plunged 8.8% intraday on Monday the 9th. Earlier reports said Huang had become a target of Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom the U.S. government suspects of being recruited by a Chinese espionage agency.
Culper gave no comment on the episode and did not reveal the size of its Nvidia short or whether it has already covered the position.
Targeting Companies Accused of Misleading Investors

Culper mainly shorts publicly listed firms it believes are misleading investors, but most of its targets are not household names. The firm has previously issued reports on Rumble, AppLovin and LifeMD.

One of Lamarco’s more high‑profile short cases was a bet last year that air‑taxi company Archer Aviation (ACHR‑US) would see its stock fall. At the time, TV host Jimmy Fallon invited Archer’s CEO onto The Tonight Show, and Culper subsequently offered Fallon a $1 million wager.
Founder’s Low‑Profile Background Reflects Revolutionary‑Era Spy Spirit

Lamarco is extremely low‑key. According to his LinkedIn profile (which does not list a specific employer), he interned for a $10 billion asset‑size mutual fund for one summer and then worked as an analyst for two years at a long‑short hedge fund.
Alumni publications show he graduated from Grove City College, located about 60 miles north of Pittsburgh.

Culper Research’s name derives from the "Culper Ring," a spy network created in the late 18th‑century American Revolutionary War to gather and relay intelligence on British‑occupied New York City troops.

On its website, Culper Research states: "Similarly, we conduct investment research through comprehensive, in‑depth investigations. We are dedicated to exposing companies that make false statements about operations, fail to disclose material risks, misuse funds, engage in accounting violations, or otherwise deceive investors." The site does not disclose assets under management.
Shortly after Culper revealed its Nvidia short, the tech giant’s share price hit an all‑time high, at a time when overall market enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) remained extremely strong.
Culper wrote at the time: "This is not a bet on AI failing. We are shorting Nvidia for one reason only: the company faces a serious China problem."

Nvidia’s board expressed confidence in Jensen Huang and said there is "no reason to believe national security or Nvidia confidential information has been compromised," while pledging that the investigation "will review all available information."
China has denied the related espionage allegations.

items.title: 選後首波清算！共和黨人提案彈劾赫格塞斯 川普表態力挺　專家：雖具政治象徵意義  但地緣風險溢價恐延長
items.title_en: Post‑Election First Wave of Settlements! Republicans Propose Impeaching Hegseas, Trump Backs Him; Experts Say Though Symbolically Political, Geopolitical Risk Premium May Prolong
paras: 美國國防部長赫格塞斯周一(9日)遭國會祭出彈劾程序，肯塔基州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Thomas Massie向眾議院提交決議，擬推動全院就彈劾赫格塞斯進行表決，最快在本週中登場。這是期中選舉後，共和黨內部對美伊戰爭責任歸屬的首波公開清算。
彈劾條款核心指向伊朗軍事行動。Massie決議聚焦赫格塞斯在對伊朗開戰中的主導角色，並一併檢視其在美國對葉門、委內瑞拉軍事行動中所扮演的決策地位。
美國輿論普遍將赫格塞斯視為伊朗戰事的主要推手，而這場戰事連帶推升油價與民生壓力，被視為共和黨本次期中大選慘敗的關鍵原因之一，就連總統川普也承認戰事對選情有「一定影響」。
國會兩黨反對赫格塞斯聲浪同步升溫。眾議院民主黨領袖傑弗里斯周日(8日)受訪時表態「強烈支持」彈劾，直言赫格塞斯「必須走人」。
除民主黨外，共和黨內亦有不少議員私下要求他請辭，Massie身為共和黨人卻帶頭提案，意在逼同黨議員表態：是否繼續為這場爭議戰事背書。
川普周一則明確表示，若赫格塞斯遭彈劾，他將力挺到底，並稱相關要求「不公平」。當天出席海軍戰爭學院活動的赫格塞斯也回應，若有人想就政府軍事行動追究法律責任，「他隨時奉陪」，並預告周二(10日)開記者會正式回應彈劾風波。
分析指出，彈劾案短期內未必能真正罷免赫格塞斯，參議院門檻與白宮庇護讓成案難度極高，但政治象徵意義不小：它把「伊朗戰事誰負責」從幕後拉到檯面，也讓川普政府必須持續為軍事決策辯護。
隨著調查與表決程序推進，國防部決策鏈、對伊談判節奏，以及期中選舉後的權力重組，都將被重新檢視。
專家指出，彈劾不確定性恐延長地緣風險溢價的消化期，若赫格塞斯最終去職，華府對伊朗、葉門與波斯灣航線的姿態是否轉向，將成為能源與防務類股後市觀察重點。
paras_en: U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseas was hit with an impeachment move by Congress on Monday (the 9th), as Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie filed a resolution in the House seeking a full‑chamber vote on impeaching Hegseas, potentially as early as mid‑week. This marks the first public reckoning within the GOP after the midterm elections over who bears responsibility for the U.S.–Iran war.

The core of the impeachment article targets Iran‑related military actions. Massie's resolution focuses on Hegseas’s leading role in the war against Iran and also examines his decision‑making position in U.S. operations in Yemen and Venezuela.

U.S. public opinion broadly views Hegseas as the main driver of the Iran conflict, which has pushed up oil prices and living‑cost pressures and is seen as a key factor in the Republican Party’s disastrous midterm performance. Even President Trump has acknowledged that the war had “a certain impact” on the election outcome.

Both parties in Congress are raising their voices against Hegseas. House Democratic leader Jeffries said on Sunday (the 8th) that he “strongly supports” impeachment and bluntly stated that Hegseas “must go.”

In addition to Democrats, many Republicans have privately urged him to resign. Massie, a Republican himself, led the proposal to force his fellow party members to declare whether they will continue to endorse this controversial war.

Trump made it clear on Monday that if Hegseas is impeached he will back him all the way and called the move “unfair.” At a Navy War College event the same day, Hegseas replied that anyone who wants to hold the government’s military actions legally accountable “he is ready to meet,” and announced a press conference on Tuesday (the 10th) to address the impeachment storm.

Analysts note that the impeachment is unlikely to remove Hegseas in the short term; the Senate threshold and White House protection make the case very difficult, but its symbolic political weight is significant: it pulls the question of “who is responsible for the Iran war” from behind the scenes to the forefront and forces the Trump administration to keep defending its military decisions.
As investigations and voting procedures move forward, the Defense Department’s decision‑making chain, the pace of negotiations with Iran, and the post‑midterm power reshuffle will all be re‑examined.

Experts warn that the uncertainty of impeachment could lengthen the period needed for the geopolitical risk premium to be digested. If Hegseas eventually leaves office, Washington’s stance toward Iran, Yemen and the Persian Gulf shipping lanes will become a key focus for energy and defense stocks going forward.

items.title: 挑戰台積電受挫！日本Rapidus關鍵技術卡關 2奈米晶片量產恐跳票
items.title_en: Setback for Japan's Rapidus Challenging TSMC: Key Technology Hurdle Threatens 2nm Chip Mass Production
paras: 日本政府支持的新創晶片製造商Rapidus，原定於2028年3月前量產先進晶片，如今進度落後，可能無法如期達成目標。
彭博引述消息人士報導，Rapidus尚未製造出可正常運作的靜態隨機存取記憶體（SRAM）單元，而要如期量產2奈米晶片，原本必須在今年夏季前完成這項關鍵步驟。
這意味著，這家已獲數十億美元公共資金挹注的公司，至今仍未成功製造出所有處理器都不可或缺的一種關鍵先進記憶體。
消息人士透露，工程師正承受加快進度的龐大壓力，但未能達成這項技術里程碑，顯示公司進度至少已落後數月。
重大延遲可能危及社會大眾對 Rapidus 的支持。外界普遍將 Rapidus 視為日本從零開始打造頂級晶圓代工廠、並降低對台灣先進晶片依賴的冒險嘗試。
此外，消息人士補充，無塵室內的塵埃與微粒控制，也是該公司目前正努力解決的另一項難題。
截至目前，日本政府已官方核撥逾 2 兆日圓（約 130 億美元）的國家資助款。嚴重的技術瓶頸亦可能推遲 Rapidus 於 2032 年前上市的目標。
Rapidus 發言人透過電子郵件表示：「Rapidus 將持續竭盡全力，以實現 2027 財年下半年啟動量產的目標。」公司拒絕提供技術開發的詳細資訊，並稱其屬機密內容。
發言人並表示，政府機構委託的外部專家小組已於9月提出報告，指出公司研發持續取得進展。
Rapidus董事長東哲郎上月表示，公司正按計畫推進，將如期量產，但未進一步說明。
先進邏輯晶片需要內嵌數億個SRAM單元。製造商必須以原子尺度的精準度，製造每個單元及其中的電晶體，才能避免運作失常，並確保資料穩定保存。在奈米尺度下，即使極微小的偏差，也可能導致晶片嚴重故障。
消息人士表示，Rapidus將持續推進2奈米製程，最終可能在延誤數年後取得成功。
Rapidus力圖與正於美國興建廠房的台積電(2330-TW) ，以及英特爾(INTC-US) 、三星電子(005930KS) 競爭。這些業者都在競相開發製程，以滿足AI服務供應商對更強大晶片的龐大需求。
Rapidus在日本北部北海道的工廠啟動試產線後，於去年7月宣布成功製造出可正常運作的電晶體，這是生產先進晶片的初期步驟。此後，其技術進展主要集中在發布製程設計套件（PDK）。
日本經濟產業大臣赤澤亮正上月表示，鑑於先進晶片對日本經濟安全的重要性，政府已準備持續支持Rapidus，直到公司能在財務上自立。
自Rapidus於2022年成立以來，台積電已在日本南部建成一座工廠，並計劃再興建一座生產3奈米晶片的工廠。
Rapidus獨立董事小林喜光9月接受《彭博》訪問時表示，公司目標是以至少80%的良率實現量產，也就是每生產5顆晶片，至少4顆合格。
不過，曾提出在北海道增建兩座工廠、並在月球設廠構想的執行長小池淳義，以及代表董事清水敦夫均表示，並非所有高層都認同小林對量產的定義。
paras_en: The Japanese government‑backed startup chip manufacturer Rapidus, which had planned to begin mass production of advanced chips by March 2028, is now lagging behind and may miss its target.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reports that Rapidus has yet to produce a functional static random‑access memory (SRAM) cell, a critical step that needed to be completed before this summer to stay on track for 2‑nanometer chip volume production.
This means the company, which has received billions of dollars in public funding, still has not succeeded in fabricating a key advanced memory component essential to all processors.
Sources say engineers are under intense pressure to accelerate progress, but the failure to hit this technical milestone indicates the schedule is at least several months behind.
A major delay could jeopardize public support for Rapidus. The firm is widely seen as Japan’s bold attempt to build a world‑class foundry from scratch and reduce reliance on Taiwan’s advanced chips.
In addition, sources note that dust and particle control in the cleanroom is another challenge the company is currently working to resolve.

To date, the Japanese government has officially allocated over ¥2 trillion (about $13 billion) in state funding, and the severe technical bottleneck could also push back Rapidus’s goal of going public before 2032.

A Rapidus spokesperson said by email, “Rapidus will continue to do everything possible to achieve the goal of starting volume production in the second half of fiscal 2027.” The company declined to provide detailed technical information, calling it confidential.
The spokesperson added that an external expert panel commissioned by government agencies submitted a report in September indicating ongoing progress in R&D.
Chairman Toshihiro Higashida said last month that the company is proceeding as planned and will meet its mass‑production schedule, without providing further details.

Advanced logic chips require embedding hundreds of millions of SRAM cells. Manufacturers must fabricate each cell and its transistors with atomic‑scale precision to avoid malfunctions and ensure data stability; even minute deviations at the nanometer scale can cause severe chip failures.
Sources say Rapidus will keep pushing the 2‑nm process and may eventually succeed after a delay of several years.

Rapidus aims to compete with TSMC (2330‑TW), Intel (INTC‑US) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS), which are all building fabs in the United States and racing to develop processes that meet the huge demand from AI service providers for more powerful chips.

After launching a pilot line at its Hokkaido plant in northern Japan, Rapidus announced in July last year that it had successfully produced a functional transistor, an early step in advanced chip production. Since then, its technical work has focused on releasing a process design kit (PDK).

Japan’s Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry, Akazawa Ryōsei, said last month that given the importance of advanced chips to Japan’s economic security, the government is prepared to continue supporting Rapidus until it becomes financially self‑sufficient.
Since Rapidus was founded in 2022, TSMC has built a plant in southern Japan and plans to construct another fab to produce 3‑nm chips.

Independent director Yoshimitsu Kobayashi told Bloomberg in September that the company’s goal is to achieve mass production with at least an 80% yield – meaning at least four good chips out of every five produced.

However, CEO Jun‑yoshi Oike, who has floated ideas of adding two more factories in Hokkaido and even building a plant on the Moon, and representative director Atsuo Shimizu both indicated that not all senior executives share Kobayashi’s definition of acceptable yield.

items.title: 赫格塞斯遭共和黨議員提8項彈劾！川普表態力挺防長、眾院本周恐表決
items.title_en: Defense Secretary Hegseth Faces Eight-Article Impeachment from GOP Lawmaker; Trump Backs Him, House Likely to Vote This Week
paras: 美國國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）面臨彈劾危機，共和黨籍肯塔基州聯邦眾議員馬西（Thomas Massie）周一（9日）正式提出8項彈劾條款，要求將赫格塞斯免職。由於眾議院彈劾案具有優先處理權，眾院最晚須在本周內對相關決議採取行動，最快可能本周就進行表決。
根據《CNBC》報導，馬西提出的8項指控包括，違反國會通過的戰爭權力決議發動戰爭、涉及加勒比海打擊疑似毒品走私船隻的法外殺戮，以及透過針對亞利桑那州民主黨籍聯邦參議員、退役軍人凱利（Mark Kelly）的行動壓制言論自由。
馬西在眾議院院會宣讀彈劾條款時指出，赫格塞斯的行為顯示，只要繼續留任，就會對美國憲法構成威脅，其行事方式也嚴重違背職責與法治原則，因此應接受彈劾審判、免職，並禁止再擔任任何美國公職。
這場彈劾行動也發生在共和黨選舉受挫之後。上周期中選舉，民主黨在眾議院與參議院均取得多數席次。包括副總統范斯（JD Vance）在內的多名共和黨人士，將選舉失利歸咎於赫格塞斯主導的伊朗戰爭。

川普力挺赫格塞斯：即使遭彈劾也會支持

不過，美國總統川普周一（9日）再次公開力挺赫格塞斯，表示即使國防部長遭到彈劾，他仍會繼續支持對方。
川普在白宮向媒體表示，赫格塞斯「打贏了兩場戰爭」，並稱他在提升美軍招募方面表現出色，目前甚至有大批民眾排隊等候加入軍隊。川普強調，赫格塞斯「做得非常好」。
川普在第一個總統任期內曾兩度遭到眾議院彈劾。
馬西提出的決議案將迫使眾議院共和黨領導層在本周結束前，安排對該案進行表決。彈劾決議案具有優先處理權，意味著眾議院必須在兩個立法日內採取行動，包括處理該案、擱置議案，或表決是否將其交付委員會審查。
共和黨目前在眾議院以218席對214席維持極微弱的多數優勢，意味著只要少數共和黨議員倒戈，就可能使赫格塞斯遭到眾議院彈劾。
眾議院共和黨領導層尚未說明打算如何處理針對赫格塞斯的彈劾案；選舉過後，他們是否掌握足夠票數讓馬西的決議案不獲通過，目前也仍不明朗。
馬西本人則已在今年5月共和黨初選中落敗，未能取得連任提名。

國會曾彈劾國安部長　赫格塞斯若遭彈劾將交參院審判

美國國會有權彈劾內閣部長，但這類情況相當罕見。最近一次遭彈劾的內閣官員，是2024年因處理美墨邊境問題而遭眾議院彈劾的國土安全部長馬約卡斯（Alejandro Mayorkas）。
在此之前，上一次內閣部長遭彈劾已是1876年，當時的戰爭部長貝爾納普（William Belknap）遭到彈劾。不過，馬約卡斯與貝爾納普最後都未在參議院審判中被定罪。
如果眾議院表決通過彈劾赫格塞斯，後續將由參議院負責舉行審判，並表決是否將這位部長免職。若參議院以三分之二多數認定赫格塞斯有罪，他就會遭到免職。
眾議院少數黨領袖、紐約州民主黨籍眾議員傑佛瑞斯（Hakeem Jeffries）周一在國會大廈舉行記者會，再次表態支持彈劾赫格塞斯。
他表示：「赫格塞斯濫用職權、損害美國國家安全，而且他是這場魯莽、代價高昂且失敗的伊朗選擇性戰爭的策劃者。」
赫格塞斯似乎也已開始為可能到來的彈劾攻防做準備。他上周發布影片，為自己領導五角大廈期間的行動辯護；國防部也主導一項媒體宣傳活動，口號為「站穩立場、投入戰鬥、捍衛共和國」。
赫格塞斯周一宣布，將於周二（10日）上午在五角大廈舉行記者會。他上一次舉行記者會是在5月5日，當時距離伊朗戰爭爆發剛超過兩個月。
paras_en: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing an impeachment crisis after Republican Kentucky Representative Thomas Massie formally introduced eight articles of impeachment on Monday (the 9th), seeking his removal. Because the House has priority jurisdiction over impeachment, it must act on the resolution by the end of this week, with a vote potentially as early as this week.

According to CNBC, Massie's eight charges include violating the war powers resolution passed by Congress to launch war, unlawful killings in a Caribbean operation targeting suspected drug‑smuggling vessels, and suppressing free speech through actions aimed at Democratic Senator and former astronaut Mark Kelly of Arizona.

When reading the articles on the House floor, Mass argued that Hegseth’s conduct threatens the U.S. Constitution if he remains in office, grossly violates his duties and the rule of law, and therefore warrants impeachment, removal, and a ban on holding any future U.S. public office.

The impeachment move comes after recent Republican electoral setbacks. In last week’s midterms, Democrats captured majorities in both the House and Senate, and several GOP figures, including Vice‑President JD Vance, blamed the losses on Hegseth’s leadership of the war in Iran.

Trump backs Hegseth: He will support him even if impeached

Nevertheless, former President Donald Trump publicly reaffirmed his support for Hegseth on Monday (the 9th), saying he would continue to back the secretary even if he were impeached.

Trump told reporters at the White House that Hegseth “won two wars,” praised his performance in boosting military recruitment—so much so that large crowds are now lining up to enlist—and emphasized that Hegseth “has done a very good job.”
Trump was himself impeached twice by the House during his first term.

Mass’s resolution forces House Republican leaders to schedule a vote on the matter before the end of the week. The impeachment resolution enjoys priority status, meaning the House must act within two legislative days—either moving forward, shelving other business, or deciding whether to refer it to a committee.
Republicans hold a razor‑thin majority in the House, 218 seats to 214. A small number of GOP members breaking ranks could be enough to tip the vote toward impeaching Hegseth.

House Republican leadership has not yet explained how it will handle the impeachment effort against Hegseth; it remains unclear whether they have enough votes after the election to block Mass’s resolution.
Mass himself lost his GOP primary in May, failing to secure the party’s nomination for re‑election.

Congress has the authority to impeach cabinet secretaries, though such cases are rare. The most recent cabinet official to be impeached was Secretary of Homeland Security Alejandro Mayorkas, who was impeached by the House in 2024 over his handling of the U.S.–Mexico border.
The previous impeachment of a cabinet member dates back to 1876, when Secretary of War William Belknap was impeached. Neither Mayorkas nor Belknap were ultimately convicted by the Senate.
If the House votes to impeach Hegseth, the Senate will conduct a trial and decide whether to remove him. A two‑thirds Senate vote finding him guilty would result in his removal from office.
House Minority Leader and New York Democrat Hakeem Jeffries held a press conference at the Capitol on Monday, reiterating his support for impeaching Hegseth.
He said, “Hegseth abused his authority, jeopardized U.S. national security, and was the architect of this reckless, costly, and failed selective war in Iran.”

Hegseth appears to be preparing for the upcoming impeachment battle. He released a video last week defending his actions while leading the Pentagon, and the Defense Department launched a media campaign with the slogan “Stand Firm, Engage the Fight, Defend the Republic.”
Hegseth announced on Monday that he will hold a press briefing at the Pentagon on Tuesday (the 10th) morning. His last briefing was on May 5, just over two months after the Iran war began.

items.title: 美三名眾議員敦促停止對中AI晶片出口要求商務部12月1日前答覆
items.title_en: Three U.S. House Representatives Urge Halt to AI Chip Exports to China, Ask Commerce Department for Reply by Dec. 1
paras: 2026年11月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國眾議院外交委員會三名民主黨議員致函商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick），要求立即停止向中國出口先進AI晶片。根據外媒路透報導，議員並要求商務部在12月1日前答覆，說明高層對相關情報與國家安全疑慮的知情及處理情況。這是議員提出的政策要求，並非商務部已宣布實施的新禁令。
委員會民主黨9日公布的新聞稿指出，聯署者包括首席議員Gregory Meeks、副首席議員Gabe Amo，以及南亞與中亞小組委員會民主黨首席議員Sydney Kamlager-Dove。三人要求商務部交代，在媒體報導輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與疑涉中國情報活動人士的往來後，為何仍允許相關晶片出口。
路透指出，議員詢問商務部高層是否知悉涉及Megaspeed前主管Alice Huang、以及中國取得輝達晶片的情報，並追問是否曾就Alice Huang與Megaspeed和國務卿盧比歐溝通。信函要求釐清商務部何時獲知資訊，以及接獲資訊後採取哪些措施。
輝達董事會已宣布獨立調查，釐清黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的目標，並表示目前沒有理由認定美國國家安全或公司機密受到損害。相關情報指控仍待釐清，中國外交部則否認間諜指控。此次議員致函不代表調查已有結論，也不等於現行出口許可已被撤銷。

paras_en: On November 10, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Three Democratic members of the House Foreign Affairs Committee wrote to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, demanding an immediate stop to the export of advanced AI chips to China. According to Reuters, the lawmakers also asked the Commerce Department to respond by Dec. 1, explaining senior officials' awareness of and handling of the related intelligence and national‑security concerns. This is a policy request from the members, not a newly announced ban by the Commerce Department.

The committee’s Democratic press release on the 9th listed the co‑signers as Chair Gregory Meeks, Vice‑Chair Gabe Amo, and Subcommittee on South Asia and Central Asia Chair Sydney Kamlager‑Dove. The three demanded that the Commerce Department explain why, after media reports of NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang’s contacts with individuals allegedly involved in Chinese intelligence activities, the relevant chip exports are still permitted.

Reuters noted that the lawmakers asked whether senior Commerce officials were aware of the involvement of former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang and of Chinese intelligence gathering on NVIDIA chips, and whether they had communicated about Alice Huang, Megaspeed, and Secretary of State Antony Blinken. The letter seeks clarification on when the department learned of the information and what actions were taken thereafter.

NVIDIA’s board has launched an independent investigation to determine whether Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations, stating that there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or corporate secrets have been compromised. The alleged intelligence allegations remain unresolved, and China’s foreign ministry has denied any espionage accusations. The lawmakers’ letter does not indicate that the investigation has reached a conclusion nor that existing export licenses have been revoked.

items.title_en: AI Stocks Oversold! Morgan Stanley Warns Not to Sell Blindly: Data Center Buildouts Only Delayed, Not Canceled – Still Backing Amazon, Microsoft and the Other Three "Knights"
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)出具最新研究報告指出，近期市場因憂心美國期中大選結果恐拖累資料中心建設，引發AI概念股一輪拋售，但這波跌勢明顯反應過度。
大摩強調，AI資本支出大趨勢未變，部分項目僅是時程遞延而非取消，超大型雲端服務商的投資計畫大體維持不變。
大摩表示，原先預計2028年落成的約5GW美國資料中心規劃容量，可能順延至2029年，但不會被一刀砍除。這種「建設節奏微調」反而有助紓解短期供應鏈瓶頸、支撐算力定價，進而拉長整個AI投資周期的能見度。
在標的選擇上，大摩重申看好亞馬遜、微軟、Meta與Alphabet等主要AI受惠股，並在半導體、基礎設施與軟體領域中也搜尋到具吸引力的布局機會。
大摩認為，市場將選舉變數過度解讀為結構性逆風，卻忽略雲端巨頭穩健的現金流與算力剛性需求。短期震盪反而為長線資金創造進場良機，AI基礎設施擴張的長期路徑依然清晰。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (hereafter "MS") issued a latest research report noting that recently the market, worried that the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections could drag on data‑center construction, triggered a round of selling in AI‑concept stocks, but this drop appears to be an overreaction.

MS emphasized that the overall trend of AI capital spending remains unchanged; some projects are merely postponed rather than cancelled, and the investment plans of the ultra‑large cloud service providers remain broadly intact.

MS said that the roughly 5 GW of U.S. data‑center capacity originally slated for completion in 2028 may be pushed to 2029, but will not be cut outright. This modest “construction‑pace adjustment” could actually ease short‑term supply‑chain bottlenecks, support compute pricing, and extend the visibility of the entire AI investment cycle.

Regarding stock selection, MS reiterated its bullish view on primary AI beneficiaries such as Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Alphabet, and also identified attractive positioning opportunities in semiconductors, infrastructure and software.

MS believes the market has over‑interpreted the election variable as a structural headwind, overlooking the cloud giants’ solid cash flows and the rigid demand for compute. The short‑term wobble instead creates a good entry point for long‑term capital, and the long‑term path for AI‑infrastructure expansion remains clear.

items.title: 電動皮卡Cybertruck明年停產 馬斯克：將向大批客戶退還訂金
items.title_en: Tesla Cybertruck Electric Pickup to Cease Production Next Year, Musk Says Deposits Will Be Refunded to Many Customers
paras: 消費者支付訂金也未必能買到最後一批下線Cybertruck電動皮卡，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克9日（周一）表示，Cybertruck訂單量「遠遠超過」明年停產前能夠完成的生產能力。
馬斯克在社交平台X上發文：「在大約8個月後關閉生產線之前，我們會盡可能生產，但也不得不向很多客戶退還訂金。」
馬斯克強調，Cybertruck並非一款虧損車型，但相比之下，擴大特斯拉Cybercab無人駕駛計程車的生產規模更重要。
他表示：「維持Cybertruck生產所帶來的複雜性，機會成本遠遠超過增加Cybercab產量所能創造的價值。」
馬斯克6日宣布，將停止生產2023年正式推出的Cybertruck。目前尚不清楚特斯拉手中還有多少未交付訂單，而特斯拉官網似乎仍在接受消費者下單。
Cybertruck最初肩負著展示特斯拉最新電動車技術、打開高利潤皮卡市場的雙重使命。馬斯克曾向投資者表示，這將是特斯拉「有史以來最好的產品」。他當時預計特斯拉每年能夠銷售25萬輛Cybertruck，但實際市場表現遠不如預期。
去年特斯拉在美國僅售出約2萬輛Cybertruck；2026年以來，累計銷量也只有1.6萬輛左右。此外，在馬斯克執掌美國政府效率部期間，Cybertruck還成為反馬斯克抗議活動和惡意破壞行為的目標。
與此同時，Cybertruck的市場表現也恰逢美國電動車市場走弱。消費者需求未能達到汽車製造商預期，整個電動車行業的發展勢頭隨之放緩。
美國電動車稅額抵免政策終止加劇了這一趨勢。頗具諷刺意味的是，推動這一政策變化的正是美國總統川普及共和黨主導的國會。
paras_en: Consumers who paid deposits may still not receive the final batch of the Cybertruck electric pickup, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk said on Monday the 9th that Cybertruck order volume "far exceeds" the production capacity that can be completed before the shutdown next year.
Musk posted on X: "We will produce as much as possible before we shut the line down in about eight months, but we will also have to refund deposits to many customers."
Musk stressed that the Cybertruck is not an unprofitable model, but expanding production of Tesla’s Cybercab autonomous taxi fleet is comparatively more important.
He added: "Maintaining the complexity of Cybertruck production carries an opportunity cost far greater than the value that could be created by increasing Cybercab output."

Musk announced on the 6th that production of the Cybertruck, officially launched in 2023, will be halted. It remains unclear how many undelivered orders Tesla still holds, and the Tesla website appears to still be accepting consumer orders.

The Cybertruck was originally tasked with showcasing Tesla’s latest EV technology and opening the high‑margin pickup market. Musk had told investors it would be "the best product Tesla has ever made" and projected annual sales of 250,000 units, but actual market performance fell far short of expectations.

Last year Tesla sold only about 20,000 Cybertrucks in the United States; since 2026 cumulative sales have been roughly 16,000. Moreover, during Musk’s tenure heading the U.S. Department of Efficiency, the Cybertruck became a target of anti‑Musk protests and vandalism.

At the same time, the Cybertruck’s market performance coincided with a weakening U.S. electric‑vehicle market. Consumer demand failed to meet automakers’ expectations, slowing the overall momentum of the EV industry.
The termination of the U.S. EV tax‑credit policy has intensified this trend, a change driven paradoxically by President Trump and a Republican‑controlled Congress.

items.title: 看好AI廣告變現 摩通焦點名單納Meta、移除Alphabet
items.title_en: Optimistic about AI Ad Monetization, JPMorgan Adds Meta and Removes Alphabet from Focus List
paras: 摩根大通將Meta(META-US)納入「分析師焦點名單」(Analyst Focus List)，同時移除Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，看好Meta透過人工智慧(AI)改善廣告成效，帶動近期獲利成長。不過，這項調整不代表摩根大通轉空Alphabet，該行仍維持其「加碼」(Overweight)評等。
摩根大通分析師Doug Anmuth在9日報告中寫道：「第三季財報公布後，Meta相對於同業的廣告優勢，比以往任何時候都更加明顯。」調整後，Meta與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)成為摩根大通網路股研究範圍內的偏好標的。
Anmuth指出，Meta第三季廣告營收年增26%，北美市場增幅加速至33%。摩根大通估計，Meta當季新增廣告營收約130億美元，約為Google搜尋新增金額的兩倍，並預期Meta旗下應用程式家族的廣告營收，自第四季起將超越Google搜尋。
摩根大通將Meta廣告業務的成長，歸因於AI改善廣告檢索、排序及受眾鎖定，協助提高廣告轉換率。該行也認為，Meta龐大的廣告客戶基礎及跨產業布局，有助降低個別產業廣告支出疲弱的影響。
除了核心廣告業務，Anmuth也看好Meta的AI產品商機，包括Meta Model API與Muse Code的企業市場機會。相較之下，摩根大通認為，Alphabet改善AI搜尋變現的成效，可能仍需要時間。
摩根大通指出，Google搜尋第三季營收年增率放緩至12%，低於第一季的19%及第二季的17%，儘管Google表示，搜尋查詢量創下五年來最快成長速度。
Google管理層將匯率列為搜尋營收成長減速的最大因素，其他原因包括歐盟調整小額包裹免稅規定後，亞洲零售商減少支出，以及世界盃結束後，媒體與娛樂業的廣告支出下降。
摩根大通仍看好Google，但認為AI搜尋的變現改善可能需要時間。《The Fly》引述該行報告指出，Alphabet未來幾季的利潤率，也可能受到過渡性運算資源協議的壓力。
這次名單調整的重點，是摩根大通對兩家公司AI變現進度的不同評估。該行認為，Meta的AI技術已在改善核心廣告業務的經濟效益，新消費者與企業產品則提供額外成長機會；Alphabet雖維持「加碼」評等，卻不再列於該行最偏好的網路股之中。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase has added Meta (META-US) to its Analyst Focus List while removing Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US), betting that Meta will boost recent profit growth by using artificial intelligence (AI) to improve ad performance. The move does not signal a bearish stance on Alphabet, as the firm retains an Overweight rating on the stock.

JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth wrote in a report on the 9th that “after the Q3 earnings release, Meta’s advertising advantage over peers is clearer than ever.” After the adjustment, Meta and Amazon (AMZN-US) become JPMorgan’s preferred names within its internet‑stock research coverage.

Anmuth noted that Meta’s Q3 ad revenue grew 26% year‑over‑year, with North America accelerating to a 33% increase. JPMorgan estimates Meta added about $13 billion of ad revenue that quarter, roughly twice Google Search’s incremental amount, and expects Meta’s family of apps to surpass Google Search in ad revenue starting in Q4.

JPMorgan attributes Meta’s ad‑business growth to AI‑enhanced ad retrieval, ranking and audience targeting, which lifts conversion rates. The firm also believes Meta’s massive advertiser base and cross‑industry reach help cushion the impact of weak ad spend in any single sector.

Beyond its core ad business, Anmuth is bullish on Meta’s AI product opportunities, including the Meta Model API and Muse Code for enterprise markets. By contrast, JPMorgan thinks Alphabet’s progress in monetizing AI‑enhanced search may still take time.

JPMorgan points out that Google Search’s Q3 revenue year‑over‑year growth slowed to 12%, down from 19% in Q1 and 17% in Q2, even though Google said search query volume hit its fastest five‑year growth rate.

Google’s management cites currency effects as the biggest drag on search‑revenue growth, with other factors including reduced spending by Asian retailers after the EU adjusted low‑value parcel tax exemptions and a dip in media and entertainment ad spend following the World Cup’s end.

JPMorgan remains positive on Google but believes improvements in AI‑search monetization will take time. “The Fly” quoted the firm’s report saying Alphabet’s profit margins in upcoming quarters could also be pressured by transitional compute‑resource agreements.

The focus‑list change underscores JPMorgan’s differing assessments of the two companies’ AI‑monetization progress. The firm sees Meta’s AI already enhancing the economics of its core ad business and offering new consumer and enterprise growth avenues, while Alphabet, despite retaining an Overweight rating, is no longer among the firm’s top‑preferred internet stocks.

items.title_en: Jensen Huang Hired Crisis PR Firm Before Affair Was Exposed; Heller Inc. Has Handled Multiple High‑Profile Sex Scandals
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳據傳早在公開承認婚外情前至少一年，就已聘請一家曾協助知名人士處理性醜聞與性不當指控的危機公關公司Heller Inc.。
根據《Wired》報導，2025年10月《紐約時報》刊出一篇探討輝達是否協助中國企業規避美國晶片出口限制的報導後不久，輝達內部公關團隊便接獲指示，凡是媒體詢問黃仁勳相關問題，都應將Heller Inc.列入電子郵件副本。
《紐時》當時報導，一家與中國有關聯、當時鮮為人知的新加坡資料中心公司Megaspeed，已取得價值近20億美元的輝達晶片。
報導也提到，Megaspeed執行長黃樂（Alice Huang），也就是後來被指與黃仁勳有關聯的女性，曾在台北一場輝達客戶聚會上站在黃仁勳身旁。
根據《紐約雜誌》2023年的一篇人物專題，Heller Inc.創辦人海勒（Risa Heller）曾協助多名知名男性處理個人醜聞及性不當行為指控。
據報導，她的客戶包括前任美國眾議院議員韋納（Anthony Weiner）、名廚巴塔利（Mario Batali），以及《紐約客》（The New Yorker）前撰稿人圖賓（Jeffrey Toobin）。
黃樂後來也因與黃仁勳的關係受到關注。輝達周日（8日）公布黃仁勳的一份聲明，他在聲明中承認曾與一名前Megaspeed高層發生婚外情，但並未點名黃樂。
另一方面，輝達董事會也宣布將展開獨立調查，理由是有報導指出，黃仁勳「曾成為外國情報機構行動的目標」。
截至目前，Heller Inc.與輝達均未立即回應媒體的置評請求。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is reported to have hired crisis‑public‑relations firm Heller Inc., which has helped well‑known figures manage sexual scandal and misconduct allegations, at least a year before he publicly admitted to an extramarital affair.

According to Wired, shortly after the New York Times ran a October 2025 story examining whether NVIDIA helped Chinese firms evade U.S. chip export restrictions, NVIDIA’s internal PR team was instructed to copy Heller Inc. on any media inquiries about Jensen Huang.
The New York Times reported that a little‑known Singapore data‑center company with ties to China, Megaspeed, had secured nearly $2 billion worth of NVIDIA chips.
The report also noted that Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang, the woman later alleged to have a connection with Jensen Huang, stood beside him at a NVIDIA customer gathering in Taipei.
A 2023 New York Magazine profile said Heller Inc. founder Risa Heller has assisted several high‑profile men in handling personal scandals and sexual‑misconduct accusations.
Her client list reportedly includes former U.S. Representative Anthony Weiner, celebrity chef Mario Batali, and former New Yorker writer Jeffrey Toobin.

Alice Huang later drew scrutiny for her alleged link to Jensen Huang. On Sunday the 8th, NVIDIA released a statement in which Huang admitted to an affair with a former Megaspeed executive, without naming Alice Huang.
Separately, NVIDIA’s board announced it will launch an independent investigation after reports suggested Huang “has become a target of foreign intelligence operations.”
To date, neither Heller Inc. nor NVIDIA has responded to media requests for comment.

items.title: 川普再談AI：風險可控 不介意設監管護欄
items.title_en: Trump Talks AI Again: Risks Controllable, No Objection to Setting Regulatory Guardrails
paras: 美國矽谷和政界有關AI安全的爭論持續發酵，美國總統川普表示，人工智慧（AI）帶來的風險可控，他同時也釋放出對安全保障措施持開放態度的信號，他在一檔節目中表示，「不介意設置護欄」。
當被問及美國是否應該為了保持在AI領域的領先優勢而接受相關風險時，川普說，這些危險可控，並表達了願意與民主黨合作制定相關保障措施的意願。
「我不介意設置監管護欄。」但川普不希望監管措施導致美國在AI領域落後。
川普此前一直傾向於讓科技公司進行自我監管，而不是由政府實施全面限制。他的最新言論表明，他對AI監管持某種開放態度。
過去幾個月，川普一再淡化AI風險，曾多次將AI風險相關論調稱為「騙局」。 他反覆重申反對減緩AI發展速度的立場。
paras_en: The debate over AI safety continues to simmer in Silicon Valley and Washington, and U.S. President Donald Trump says the risks posed by artificial intelligence are manageable. He also signaled an openness to safety safeguards, telling a TV program that he "doesn't mind putting up guardrails."

When asked whether the United States should accept related risks in order to maintain its lead in AI, Trump replied that the dangers are controllable and expressed a willingness to work with Democrats to craft appropriate safeguards.
"I don't mind setting regulatory guardrails," Trump said, but he added that he does not want regulation to cause the United States to fall behind in the AI race.
Trump has previously favored letting tech companies self‑regulate rather than imposing sweeping government restrictions. His latest remarks indicate a somewhat more open stance toward AI regulation.

In recent months, Trump has repeatedly downplayed AI risks, calling concerns about AI a "scam" on several occasions, and has consistently reiterated his opposition to slowing the pace of AI development.

items.title: 高盛點名！AI股下跌首選避險貨幣標的：日元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Names AI Stock Decline Hedge: Japanese Yen
paras: 高盛最新表示，儘管近期美股回檔時，日元避險屬性表現平淡，但若AI概念股進一步走低，日元仍是最佳貨幣避險工具。
由Kamakshya Trivedi領銜的策略師在報告中指出，市場無需過度外推近期美元兌日元與科技股的弱聯動關係，仍有多項理由支撐日圓避險價值。
數據顯示，自10月初以來，在那斯達克指數表現落後標普500的交易日內，美元兌日元平均走低，上周四(5日)股市暴跌當日也不例外。美元兌日元與AI相關股票日報酬率的一個月滾動相關性，已飆升至今年以來最高水準。
根據高盛策略師分析，上周四股市重挫、隔日反彈的走勢，反映出波動主因更可能是倉位調整，而非AI產業基本面預期惡化。
他們判斷，若全球經濟前景明顯轉差，匯市波動率將攀升，日元表現有望跑贏其他主要貨幣。做空美元兌日元作為對沖工具的效果將更顯著，但前提是，基本面預期必須出現比當前更大、更廣泛的轉變。
該投行也重申，投資人不應輕忽日元的防禦性配置價值，在AI敘事持續擾動市場的環境下，日元仍是對沖科技股回檔風險的首選貨幣。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs recently said that although the yen’s hedge property has been muted during the recent pullback in U.S. equities, if AI‑related stocks fall further the yen remains the best currency hedge tool.

Strategists led by Kamakshya Trivedi noted in the report that the market need not over‑extrapolate the recent weak correlation between the dollar‑yen pair and tech stocks, as there are still many reasons to support the yen’s hedge value.

Data show that since early October, on trading days when the Nasdaq lagged the S&P 500, the dollar‑yen pair tended to weaken, and last Thursday (the 5th) when the market crashed was no exception. The one‑month rolling correlation between the dollar‑yen and daily returns of AI‑related stocks has surged to its highest level this year.

According to Goldman strategists, last Thursday’s sharp market drop and the next‑day rebound suggest that the main driver of volatility was more likely position‑adjustment rather than a deterioration in AI industry fundamentals.

They judge that if the global economic outlook clearly worsens, FX volatility will rise and the yen is likely to outperform other major currencies. Shorting the dollar‑yen as a hedge will become more effective, provided that fundamental expectations shift larger and more broadly than they do today.

The bank also reiterated that investors should not overlook the defensive value of the yen; in an environment where the AI narrative continues to stir markets, the yen remains the top currency for hedging against tech‑stock pullbacks.

英國招聘與就業聯合會(REC)和會計師事務所畢馬威(KPMG)週一公布的聯合月度調查顯示，10月長期員工招聘指數降至46.6，為5月以來最低水平，同時臨時員工招聘指數降至48.9，是自3月以來首次下滑，拖累英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3342低點；隨後因人工智能(AI)相關擔憂有所緩解，且美國總統川普淡化了再次對伊朗發動襲擊的可能性，隨著油價下跌，推漲英鎊兌美元回漲至1.3442高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3475-95，支撐於1.3405-25。

U.S. October employment growth accelerated, with the unemployment rate falling to 4.1%. The closely watched jobs report also showed that August and September added a combined 84,000 jobs, upward revisions from earlier estimates. This extra labor may help absorb cost‑of‑living pressure caused by the Middle‑East conflict, and as the labor market regains momentum after a mid‑year slowdown, it boosts the odds that the Federal Reserve will raise rates in December. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees about an 80% probability of a Fed hike next month, supporting the dollar. In addition, Japan’s Ministry of Finance released quarterly data showing that Japanese authorities carried out a record‑size one‑day yen‑buying intervention from July 30 to August 3, with the July 30 operation alone reaching ¥7.98 trillion – the largest single‑day intervention since data began in 1991. By the end of October Japan’s foreign‑exchange reserves had risen to $1.179 trillion. However, the widening U.S.–Japan bond spread and expectations of further Fed tightening have kept the dollar/yen range around the 158.53 high.

U.S. official data showed September wholesale inventories and sales grew 2.8% and 0.7% month‑over‑month, and the October Employment Trend Index rose to 108.36. Yet a New York Fed survey found the share of respondents expecting higher unemployment a year from now had risen to its highest level since April 2020, and Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin warned that policy adjustments should be made cautiously as the Fed considers how to tackle inflation. This weighed on the dollar, pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 157.65. The dollar is seen facing resistance at 158.20‑40 and support at 157.40‑60 today.
EUR/USD

RBA Deputy Governor Hunt said there is still no solid evidence that artificial intelligence has significantly boosted productivity or caused large‑scale job losses. With AI‑related stocks rallying and market sentiment improving, and with concerns over an escalation of the Iran conflict easing, the New Zealand election remains too close to call – the official result won’t be released until November 27, though Prime Minister Christopher Luxon’s centre‑right coalition still holds a slim majority. These factors have supported risk‑sensitive currencies, lifting both the Australian and New Zealand dollars and helping the euro recover from its 1.1135 low against the dollar.

German Federal Statistics Office data showed September’s seasonally adjusted trade surplus fell to €15.6 billion, but both exports and imports rose 4.2% and 2.0% month‑over‑month, far above market expectations. The Euro‑zone Sentix index for November slipped to +2.4, confirming expectations of a stagnant economy, though the decline was milder than feared. The euro therefore steadied around the 1.1225 high against the dollar. Resistance for EUR/USD is estimated at 1.1255‑75 with support at 1.1190‑1.1210 today.
GBP/USD

A joint monthly survey by the Recruitment and Employment Confederation (REC) and accounting firm KPMG released on Monday showed the October long‑term hiring index fell to 46.6, the lowest since May, while the temporary hiring index dropped to 48.9 – the first decline since March. This pulled the pound down to a low of 1.3342 against the dollar. However, as AI‑related worries eased and former President Trump downplayed the likelihood of another attack on Iran, oil prices fell and the pound rebounded to a high of 1.3442. Resistance for GBP/USD is seen at 1.3475‑95 with support at 1.3405‑25 today.

paras: 美元對主要貨幣周一(9日)下滑，歐元、日元皆攀高，主因是美國總統川普表示只要外交努力持續推進，他非常不可能對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，中東戰爭加劇的疑慮緩解，促使投資人在上周人工智慧(AI)股拋售潮後重新轉進風險資產。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)下跌0.47%，報101.75。
歐元兌美元最新上漲0.64%，報1.1213美元。美元兌日元下跌0.41%，報157.89日元。
川普預定周一會晤卡達首相穆罕默德(Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani)，顯示各方正尋求衝突加速結束，外交斡旋持續升溫。
市場氣氛好轉也削弱美元的避險吸引力，布蘭特原油期貨則下跌近6%，收在每桶92.57美元。
Ebury首席經濟學家Enrique Diaz-Alvarez說：「目前美元空頭部位與交易的一大問題是市場持倉。積極參與交易與投機的市場參與者持有大量美元多頭部位，這意味著美元很難進一步上漲。我們預期歐元中期將反彈，因為市場可能低估了歐元區經濟復甦的力道。」
Diaz-Alvarez進一步說：「市場有些低估美國期中選舉對美國經濟的影響，AI投資一直是美國經濟表現的重要組成部分，而美國這次重大的政治變化，從邊際效應來看，將對這類投資產生負面影響。」
美股大盤周一上揚，以科技股為主的那斯達克指數領漲，扭轉上周經歷的一波猛烈賣壓。
由Shaun Osborne領軍的豐業銀行(Scotiabank)分析師團隊說：「市場焦點仍集中在美國科技股交易持續降溫，投資人也必須因應部分產業龍頭個股各自面臨的問題。」

美國通膨數據成焦點

投資人將關注周二公布的美國消費者物價指數(CPI)，分析師預估10月CPI月增率將達0.3%。

對風險較敏感的澳幣與紐元同步走揚。澳幣上揚0.95%，報0.6922美元，紐元勁揚1.54%，報0.56301美元。交易員同時也正在評估紐西蘭周末選舉結果難分勝負可能帶來的影響。

paras: 最新外匯策略報告顯示，即便AI投資熱潮引發資本市場震盪，美元基本面支撐並未動搖。對此巴克萊表示，美國經濟數據維持強勁，AI資本開支週期短期內大幅下修機率不高，因此繼續看好美元回檔後逢低買進的交易策略。
目前，美元風險溢價已回落至約1%，創一年多以來最低。機構分析指出，受歐元空頭部位擁擠影響，歐元兌美元或階段性反彈至1.14附近，但依托美國宏觀經濟的持續韌性，這一輪上行情難以持續。
巴克萊引用1858年巨型遠洋郵輪「大東方號」建造往事作為類比：該計畫投資耗資巨大、一波三折，最終推動跨洋海底電報電纜落地，也衍生出匯市術語「cable」。
報告認為，當下AI投資浪潮是上世紀網路熱潮之後，規模宏大、前景未知的重大技術投資週期，市場正重新定價風險與報酬。
市場擔憂AI資本開支潛藏多重隱患：算力需求是否存在虛高、產業鏈交叉融資會否形成連鎖風險、資料中心建設面臨的地方政治阻力等。
但巴克萊判斷指出，存量資料中心建設項目將穩步落地，超大規模雲廠商並未放緩投資借貸計劃，預計2027年底進入正向現金流階段，算力擴容也帶動企業真實需求增長，AI技術浪潮已經成型，難以逆轉。
按幣種來看，歐元對沖美元的吸引力持續走弱。法國財政壓力疊加選舉帶來的政治不確定性，推升法國公債利差；歐洲央行終端利率預期回落至3%附近，進一步升息空間受限，歐元中期前景偏空，僅存技術性反彈機會。
日元則持續受益避險資金流入。測算顯示美股回檔幅度若擴大，美元兌日元可望向155區間靠攏，但投機部位轉為日元淨多頭，將會約束日元升值節奏。
亞洲貨幣走勢明顯分化：科技股波動拖累韓元，外資持續流出帶來上行壓力；印度盧比則因油價走低、本土AI部位有限支撐；馬來西亞林吉特則同時承受油價下跌與資料中心投資預期降溫的雙重壓力。
巴克萊總結指出，目前AI股票拋售尚未對美元形成實質衝擊，美國經濟增速高於潛在水準、通膨黏性猶存，資本開支週期短期不會出現斷崖式收縮，美元依舊具備配置價值。
paras_en: The latest foreign exchange strategy report shows that even though the AI investment boom has shaken capital markets, the fundamentals supporting the dollar remain unchanged. Barclays notes that U.S. economic data stay strong and the probability of a sharp short‑term cut in AI capital spending is low, so it continues to favor a strategy of buying the dollar on pullbacks after a rally.

Currently, the dollar risk premium has fallen to about 1%, its lowest level in over a year. The firm’s analysis points out that a crowded short position in the euro has pushed the euro‑to‑dollar rate to rebound around 1.14, but the ongoing resilience of the U.S. macroeconomy makes this upward move unlikely to sustain.

Barclays uses the 1858 construction of the massive ocean liner "Great Eastern" as an analogy: the project was hugely costly and fraught with setbacks, ultimately enabling the deployment of trans‑Atlantic telegraph cables and giving rise to the currency‑market term "cable."

The report argues that the current AI investment wave is the largest, most uncertain major technology investment cycle since the internet boom of the last century, and that markets are re‑pricing risk and reward.

Market concerns about AI capital spending include whether computing power demand is overestimated, whether cross‑industry financing could create chain risks, and the political resistance faced by data‑center construction.

However, Barclays believes that existing data‑center projects will steadily materialise, large cloud providers are not slowing their investment‑and‑borrowing plans, and by the end of 2027 they will enter a positive cash‑flow phase. Computing capacity expansion will also drive real corporate demand, and the AI technology wave is already taking shape and unlikely to reverse.

In terms of currencies, the euro’s appeal as a hedge against the dollar continues to weaken. French fiscal pressure combined with election‑related political uncertainty pushes French bond spreads higher; expectations that the European Central Bank’s terminal rate will fall to around 3% further limit room for rate hikes, making the euro’s medium‑term outlook bearish with only a technical rebound possibility.

The yen continues to benefit from safe‑haven flows. Calculations suggest that if the U.S. equity pullback widens, the dollar‑to‑yen rate could converge toward the 155 area, but speculative positions turning net long on the yen will constrain its appreciation pace.

Asian currencies show clear divergence: volatility in tech stocks drags the Korean won, continued outflows of foreign capital exert upward pressure; the Indian rupee suffers from falling oil prices and limited domestic AI support; the Malaysian ringgit faces dual pressure from lower oil prices and a cooling expectation of data‑center investment.

Barclays concludes that the current sell‑off in AI stocks has not materially impacted the dollar. U.S. growth remains above potential, inflationary stickiness persists, and the capital‑spending cycle is unlikely to experience a cliff‑like contraction in the short term, leaving the dollar still attractive for allocation.

期中選舉改變政治版圖　美元走勢面臨新考驗
2026年美國期中選舉於11月3日落幕，民主黨不僅奪回眾議院控制權，也在參議院取得多數席次，打破共和黨原先掌握的國會優勢。隨著新一屆國會預計於2027年1月3日上任，美國將形成民主黨掌控國會、共和黨掌握白宮的分立政府局面。市場開始評估，美國總統川普未來推動財政、貿易及產業政策，可能面臨更大的國會制衡，進而影響美國經濟與金融市場走向。

根據路透社11月4日報導，民主黨在期中選舉取得重大勝利後，美元指數盤中下跌0.6%，一度觸及101.27的近一個月低點；歐元兌美元上漲0.6%，升至1.1258美元，日圓也升值近0.8%，來到1美元兌157.92日圓，瑞士法郎同步走強。與此同時，美國10年期公債殖利率下滑近5個基點至4.915%。市場預期，在國會制衡下，川普政府的財政刺激力道可能縮減，AI相關支出也可能放緩，進而下修對2027年升息的預期。
由於美國近年經濟成長受到AI相關投資支撐，民主黨取得國會多數後，市場也關注未來針對科技企業及AI產業的監管方向。不過，在分立政府格局下，大規模新法案較難通過，相關監管短期內出現重大轉變的可能性有限。後續市場仍將觀察AI投資動能能否延續，以及對美國經濟成長的支撐力道。
此外，國會版圖改變也不代表川普政府的政策將全面轉向。美國總統仍握有法案否決權，部分行政權限及貿易政策也不完全受國會立法進度限制。因此，選舉結果雖然為美元帶來短期壓力，但後續走勢仍取決於經濟基本面、貨幣政策及國際市場變化。
美元後市怎麼走？掌握三大關鍵觀察指標
事實上，美元走勢受到多重因素影響。除了美國政治局勢，聯準會（Fed）貨幣政策、美國經濟數據及國際資金流向，同樣扮演重要角色。首先是美國政府政策方向：隨著國會權力結構改變，川普政府未來在財政、稅收及經貿政策上的推動空間可能受到限制。若府會政策協商陷入僵局，政策短期內較難出現重大轉變，反而可能降低市場面臨的政策不確定性。
其次是聯準會貨幣政策：美元與美國利率走勢向來緊密相關。若市場預期利率維持高檔，有助支撐美元資產吸引力；反之，若經濟成長放緩、降息預期升溫，美元則可能面臨壓力。因此，未來的通膨與就業數據依然是關鍵指標。
第三則是地緣政治與避險資金流向：美元作為全球主要交易與儲備貨幣，當國際衝突升溫、能源價格大幅波動或風險偏好下降時，資金仍會重新流向具備避險特性的美元資產，為美元帶來支撐。
換言之，期中選舉雖然改變美國政治版圖，並在短期內牽動美元走勢，但分立政府也意味著政策大幅轉向的可能性降低。未來匯率走勢仍取決於多項因素交互影響，市場除了關注川普政府與國會的互動，也須持續追蹤美債殖利率、聯準會利率決策，以及歐元區、日本等主要經濟體的貨幣政策變化，才能更全面掌握全球匯市動向。

This not only places President Trump’s policy agenda for the next two years under congressional checks, but also instantly stirs global financial markets. The dollar index fell, hitting a near one‑month low, while the euro, yen, and other major currencies strengthened. As the political map is reshuffled, market focus quickly shifts from election outcomes to policy direction, Fed rates, and economic outlook, with the dollar’s future trajectory gripping global investors’ nerves.
Midterm election reshapes the political map, presenting new tests for the dollar’s movement.

The 2026 U.S. midterm election concluded on November 3, with the Democratic Party not only regaining control of the House but also securing a majority in the Senate, breaking the Republican Party’s prior congressional advantage. With the new Congress expected to convene on January 3, 2027, the U.S. will have a divided government: Democrats controlling Congress and Republicans holding the White House. Markets are evaluating how President Trump’s fiscal, trade, and industrial policies may face greater congressional checks, potentially influencing the U.S. economy and financial markets.

According to Reuters on November 4, after the Democrats’ decisive midterm victory, the dollar index fell 0.6% intraday, briefly touching a near one‑month low of 101.27; the euro rose 0.6% against the dollar to 1.1258, the yen also appreciated nearly 0.8% to 157.92 yen per dollar, and the Swiss franc strengthened. Meanwhile, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield fell almost 5 basis points to 4.915%. Markets expect that under congressional checks, the Trump administration’s fiscal stimulus may be reduced, AI‑related spending may slow, and expectations for a 2027 rate hike may be cut.

Because recent U.S. economic growth has been supported by AI‑related investment, the Democratic majority in Congress has prompted market attention to future regulatory directions for tech companies and the AI industry. However, under a divided government, large new legislation is harder to pass, limiting the likelihood of major regulatory shifts in the short term. Markets will continue to watch whether AI investment momentum persists and its support for U.S. economic growth.

Moreover, the congressional shift does not mean the Trump administration’s policies will fully reverse. The president still holds veto power, and some executive authority and trade policy are not entirely constrained by congressional legislative progress. Thus, while the election results exert short‑term pressure on the dollar, its subsequent trajectory still depends on economic fundamentals, monetary policy, and international market changes.
How will the dollar move in the future? Three key indicators to watch.

In fact, the dollar’s movement is influenced by multiple factors. Beyond U.S. political conditions, Fed monetary policy, U.S. economic data, and international capital flows also play important roles. First is U.S. government policy direction: with the congressional power structure changed, the Trump administration’s space to push fiscal, tax, and trade policy may be limited. If policy negotiations stall, significant changes are unlikely in the short term, potentially reducing market policy uncertainty.

Second is Fed monetary policy: the dollar and U.S. interest rates have always been closely linked. If markets expect rates to stay high, it helps support the dollar’s asset appeal; conversely, if economic growth slows and rate‑cut expectations rise, the dollar may face pressure. Therefore, future inflation and employment data remain key indicators.

Third is geopolitical and safe‑haven capital flows: as the world’s main trading and reserve currency, the dollar attracts funds when international conflicts flare, energy prices swing sharply, or risk appetite declines, providing support for the dollar.

In other words, while the midterm election changes the U.S. political map and temporarily affects the dollar, a divided government also means a lower likelihood of drastic policy shifts. Future exchange rates still depend on the interaction of multiple factors; markets must monitor the Trump administration’s interaction with Congress, U.S. Treasury yields, Fed decisions, and monetary policy changes in major economies like the eurozone and Japan to fully grasp global currency market trends.

The Democratic Party's overwhelming victory in the congressional elections has raised market concerns that artificial intelligence (AI) could face stricter regulation, especially regarding data‑center construction, severely hurting US equities. The tech‑heavy Nasdaq posted its largest single‑day decline since April 2025, and on Friday Asian markets led by tech stocks saw the Japanese Nikkei plunge 7% at the open, Taiwan’s market tumble to a six‑month low, and South Korea’s index drop nearly 9% triggering circuit‑breaker rules. The stock‑market sell‑off spurred yen‑related safe‑haven buying. Meanwhile, Japan’s government reported a 2.2% year‑on‑year rise in September real wages, the ninth consecutive month of growth, giving the Bank of Japan (BOJ) grounds to keep raising rates. Former BOJ chief economist Kameda said in a Reuters interview that the BOJ is expected to hike rates in December and continue tightening next year until the policy rate reaches 2% to counter mounting inflation pressure, supporting the yen and pushing the USD/JPY low to 157.21.

According to US official data, October non‑farm payrolls added 165,000 jobs, and the combined August‑September employment gains were 84,000 higher than previously reported. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, beating expectations and bolstering the case for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Michigan’s November consumer‑confidence index rose to 51.0, and New York Fed President Williams said the US economy shows surprising resilience despite still‑high inflation, while San Francisco Fed President Daly called for further tightening, lifting the dollar to a high of 158.56 against the yen. The dollar‑yen resistance is projected at 158.70‑158.90 with support at 157.90‑158.10.
EUR/USD

Investor worries over tighter regulatory scrutiny and a slowdown in AI deployment have battered Asian tech‑heavy markets, pulling risk‑sensitive currencies such as the Australian and New Zealand dollars lower. Euro‑area retail sales fell 0.7% month‑on‑month in September and were only up 0.4% year‑on‑year, both missing forecasts. German industrial production growth slowed sharply to an annual 0.55% in September, and France’s current‑account deficit widened to €2.7 billion, pushing the euro down from its recent high of 1.1234 against the dollar.

ECB chief economist Lane later said the ECB must contain the spill‑over effects of high energy prices on broader inflation and aim to bring inflation back to its 2% target within the next one to two years. However, strong US employment data is supporting the dollar, leaving the euro trading around the low of 1.1130. The euro‑dollar resistance is estimated at 1.1160‑1.1180 with support at 1.1095‑1.1115.
GBP/USD

Subsequently, Bank of England chief economist Peel said uncertainty remains over whether a second‑round inflation effect will materialise, leaving the path of rates next year undefined, which pushed the pound down to a low of 1.3339 against the dollar. paras: 美元對主要貨幣周五(6日)勁揚，創下近五個月來最大單日漲幅，主因是美國非農就業比意料中強勁，鞏固了聯準會(Fed)下個月升息預期。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)勁揚0.77%，報102.26，創6月17日以來最大漲幅。
歐元兌美元挫跌0.67%，報1.11437美元，創10月1日以來最大單日跌幅。
美元本周上揚0.3%。歐元則下跌0.1%，連續第三周收黑。
美國勞工部公布，10月非農就業人口增加16.5萬人，遠高於經濟學家預估的6.5萬人，9月新增就業人口則上修至6萬人。失業率降至4.1%。
這份報告讓Fed有更大空間繼續升息。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，報告公布後，市場對12月會議至少升息1碼(25個基點)的預期機率回升至近80%。
美股周四重挫，市場一度預期Fed 下個月升息的機率降至約67%。標普500指數市值蒸發約3兆美元，那斯達克指數則創下19個月來最大單日百分比跌幅。市場擔憂，美國期中選舉後，政府可能對人工智慧(AI)產業建置祭出更嚴格監管，進而拖累經濟成長。
多名議員、國會幕僚及倡議人士表示，民主黨計劃在明年1月掌控美國國會後，推出大量針對AI系統及資料中心發展的新法案。

就業數據公布後市場動態轉變

在就業數據公布前，AI類股賣壓蔓延全球，帶動避險需求，美元已經走高。不過，美股在周五開盤時已趨於穩定，那斯達克指數反彈，終場上漲0.3%。
就業報告公布後，美國公債殖利率走高，10年期公債殖利率上升1.6個基點至4.85%，2年期公債殖利率則上升4.1個基點至4.52%。
Moneycorp交易與結構性商品主管Eugene Epstein說：「這又回到老問題：在任何特定時刻，美元究竟是受到避險需求帶動，還是受到利率差異影響？有時候是其中一種因素，有時候則是另一種，而且兩者可能完全背道而馳，這種情況其實不太合乎理性。」
他表示：「現在市場逐漸塵埃落定，開始消化未來兩年的新常態。我認為，接下來各項資產之間的相關性應該會開始變得更加合理。」

各國央行官員聚焦通膨問題

Fed官員周五的談話，也支持市場對升息的預期。紐約聯邦準備銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周五表示，儘管接連遭遇衝擊，美國經濟成長仍展現出顯著韌性，但通膨水準依然過高，必須讓通膨率回到2%。
另外，聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)表示，在他與所轄中西部地區企業的談話中，通膨仍是最受關注的議題之一。
舊金山聯邦準備銀行總裁戴莉(Mary Daly)則表示，即使科技股出現「令人痛苦」的拋售潮，Fed可能仍需要進一步升息。
英鎊重挫0.71%，報1.3355美元，創下9月23日以來最大單日跌幅。英鎊周四才因英格蘭銀行(BOE，央行)三年多來首度升息，一度攀抵逾七周高點，如今漲勢回吐。
英鎊本周下跌近0.3%，終止連續三周上漲的走勢，是三周以來周線首度收黑。

The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, jumped 0.77% to 102.26, its largest rise since June 17.
The euro fell 0.67% against the dollar to $1.11437, marking its biggest single‑day drop since October 1.
The dollar rose 0.3% this week, while the euro slipped 0.1%, posting a third consecutive week of losses.

The U.S. Labor Department reported that non‑farm employment increased by 165,000 in October, far above economists’ forecast of 65,000, and September’s figure was revised up to 60,000. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%.

The report gives the Fed more room to keep raising rates. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the release the market’s probability of at least a 25‑basis‑point hike at the December meeting rose to near 80%.

U.S. equities slumped heavily on Thursday, with the market at one point expecting the Fed’s hike probability to fall to about 67%. The S&P 500 lost roughly $3 trillion in market cap and the Nasdaq posted its biggest single‑day percentage drop in 19 months. Investors worry that after the mid‑term elections the government may impose stricter AI regulations, which could weigh on growth.

Several lawmakers, congressional staffers and advocates said Democrats plan to roll out a wave of new legislation targeting AI systems and data‑center development after they take control of Congress in January next year.

Market dynamics shifted after the jobs data were released. Before the report, AI‑related stocks were under sell pressure worldwide, driving safe‑haven demand and lifting the dollar. However, U.S. equities steadied by Friday’s open and the Nasdaq rebounded, ending the session up 0.3%.
Following the jobs report, U.S. Treasury yields rose, with the 10‑year yield up 1.6 basis points to 4.85% and the two‑year yield up 4.1 basis points to 4.52%.

Eugene Epstein, head of trading and structured products at Moneycorp, said: “This brings us back to the old question: at any given moment, is the dollar being driven by safe‑haven demand or by interest‑rate differentials? Sometimes it’s one, sometimes the other, and they can even move in opposite directions, which isn’t very rational.”
He added: “The market is now gradually settling and beginning to digest the new normal for the next two years. I think the correlations among assets will start to look more sensible.”

Central‑bank officials around the world focused on inflation. Fed officials’ remarks on Friday also supported market expectations for a rate hike. New York Fed President John Williams said that despite a series of shocks, the U.S. economy remains remarkably resilient, but inflation is still too high and must be brought back to 2%.
In addition, St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said that in conversations with businesses in his Mid‑West district, inflation remains one of the top concerns.
San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly noted that even though tech stocks have experienced a “painful” sell‑off, the Fed may still need to raise rates further.

The pound fell 0.71% to $1.3355, its biggest single‑day drop since September 23. The pound had risen on Thursday after the Bank of England’s first rate hike in over three years, reaching a seven‑week high before giving back the gains.
The pound is down about 0.3% this week, ending three weeks of gains and posting its first weekly loss in three weeks.
The yen weakened 0.47% against the dollar to ¥158.43. Japanese Prime Minister Kishida announced a plan to use proceeds from the Bank of Japan’s ETF sales to fund an investment program.
BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said the central bank expects potential inflation to stay near its 2% target, but acknowledged there are “some upside risks” to inflation.

paras: 美國期中選舉本周由民主黨大勝後，市場對人工智慧(AI)投資前景的疑慮升高，美國科技股遭遇賣壓，促使投資人轉向較安全的資產，日元兌美元上揚，市場策略師指出，日元正逐漸成為抵禦AI交易衝擊的有效避險工具，並可能重新展現部分傳統避險貨幣的特性。
股市重挫促使投資人轉向避險貨幣之際，日元兌美元周五一度升至一周高點，來到157.27日元，隨後漲幅收斂，亞洲周五下午回落至157.805日元。日元兌美元周四一度升值0.6%，表現優於所有G10貨幣。
分析師指出，匯市正隨著股市與債市走勢起伏，投資人正在評估民主黨贏得美國期中選舉的影響，以及這對AI交易、關稅政策和美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭可能帶來的變化。
最新一波升勢顯示，日元可能正在重拾部分傳統避險貨幣的特性。上個月科技股大跌之際，日元兌美元一度升至156.08日元，隨後回吐大部分漲幅。高盛集團(Goldman Sachs)策略師先前指出，日元正逐漸成為抵禦AI引發市場衝擊的更有效避險工具。

AI交易退潮推升避險需求 日元明年有望升至148

加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC Capital Markets)外匯策略主管Sarah Ying說：「如果AI交易持續退潮，投資人就會開始尋找資金去處。我們認為，避險貨幣的需求將會增加」，其中包括日元與瑞士法郎。
她預期，隨著投資人撤離美元計價的資產，日元到2027年底將升至148，較目前水準升值逾6%。
星展銀行(OCBC)匯市策略師Moh Siong Sim則說，若僅因AI市場疑慮就預期日元持續升值，現在可能還言之過早。
日元在市場動盪作為避險去處的特質近年來逐漸減弱，原因在於美日利差維持高檔，加上日本投資人持續將資金配置於海外，即使市場避險情緒升高，投資人仍傾向賣出日元。
野村國際(Nomura International)G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，該公司仍持有日元兌美元多頭部位，並將其稱為在股市與債券殖利率同步下跌環境中「持續表現最佳的外匯交易策略」。

paras_en: After the Democrats’ big win in this week’s U.S. midterm elections, market doubts about artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment prospects rose, prompting a sell‑off in U.S. tech stocks. Investors shifted to safer assets, lifting the yen against the dollar. Market strategists say the yen is gradually becoming an effective hedge against AI‑driven market shocks and may once again display some of the traits of a traditional safe‑haven currency.

As equity markets slumped and investors fled to safe‑haven currencies, the yen rose to a weekly high of 157.27 per dollar on Friday before easing back to 157.805 by Friday afternoon in Asia. On Thursday the yen had appreciated 0.6% against the dollar, outperforming all other G10 currencies.

Analysts note that the FX market is moving in step with equity and bond market swings as investors assess the impact of the Democrats’ midterm victory and its possible effects on AI trading, tariff policy and the U.S.–Israel war against Iran.

The latest rally suggests the yen may be regaining some of its traditional safe‑haven characteristics. When tech stocks plunged last month, the yen briefly hit 156.08 per dollar before giving back most of the gain. Goldman Sachs strategists previously warned that the yen is becoming a more effective hedge against AI‑induced market turbulence.

"If AI‑driven trading continues to recede, investors will start looking for places to park capital," said Sarah Ying, head of FX strategy at CIBC Capital Markets. "We expect demand for safe‑haven currencies, including the yen and the Swiss franc, to rise."
She forecasts that as investors pull out of dollar‑denominated assets, the yen will climb to 148 by the end of 2027, a gain of more than 6% from current levels.
OCBC FX strategist Moh Siong Sim cautioned that it may be premature to expect a sustained yen rally solely on AI‑market concerns.

The yen’s role as a safe‑haven haven has weakened in recent years because the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate gap remains high and Japanese investors continue to allocate funds overseas, so even when risk aversion spikes, they tend to sell yen.

Nomura International G10 FX chief Dominic Bunning said the firm still holds a long yen‑dollar position, calling it “the best‑performing FX strategy” in an environment where equities and bond yields are falling together.

He added that if the Bank of Japan raises rates and Japanese asset managers shift more investments from overseas bonds back to domestic markets, the yen would benefit, and further BOJ hikes should sustain the trend.
The BOJ’s next policy decision is slated for Dec. 18, and the overnight index swap market currently puts the probability of a rate hike at 76%.

Japan’s decades‑long ultra‑low rates have pushed insurers, pension funds and other investors to seek higher returns abroad. As domestic bond yields rise, even without selling existing overseas holdings, keeping more capital at home could ease the long‑standing downward pressure on the yen.
Nathan Thooft, senior portfolio manager at Manulife Investment Management, said that heightened equity volatility is reviving hedging demand, which benefits the yen.

He noted that the dollar’s challenges are the opposite: many of America’s perceived advantages are now tied to AI, so any crack in that narrative could quickly turn into a problem for the dollar itself.
